decision: Build on outbox/competition-entry at 46a3bef
why: It holds all chat-branching work; 253 tests pass

decision: Use only the plugin framework of today
why: No changes to Hermes code

decision: A tree node is one exchange
why: Forks and merges anchor to an exact exchange

decision: The merge mode is the user's choice: Full text (default), Merge record, Digest
why: Rohan's rule

decision: One git-graph view; drop the outline, gutter, and strip modes of PR 20
why: The rules describe one graph view; less code to fix before the deadline

decision: Oldest exchange at the top
why: Reads in the same order as the chat

decision: Digest is the side question plus its final answer, with no model call
why: No cost per click, deterministic, and formatSideDigest exists

decision: Every merge mode starts with "From side chat: <title>"
why: The tree finds merges from that header in the parent's messages

decision: Keep three plugins with one install script
why: A combined plugin is a risky restructure before the deadline

decision: Fork from any message (session.branch with count) after the core units
why: Hermes 0.23.1 supports count; not required by Rohan's rules

decision: Opus implements and a fresh Opus reviews each unit
why: Rohan's global rules; Outbox's mr rule does not apply here

decision: The repo is private, so the catalog cannot load it
why: Catalog entries load the repo at the pinned SHA

decision: Make the repo public later, not now
why: Not important before the build is done

decision: The merge header is "From side chat: <side question>", not the title
why: branchName cuts titles to 50 chars and Hermes can rename chats; the question is the side chat's exact first message
result: chosen; replaces the title rule in spec.md

decision: No review for each unit; one review of the whole build at the end
why: Time before the deadline

decision: The entry lives in one window, the tree pane; a side chat is a branch lane, not a separate pane
why: Rohan's product rule
result: chosen; side-chat pane leaves the entry, its code moves into chat-tree

decision: Tree colours come from the Hermes theme, after the core units
why: Rohan's request

decision: Branch at any exchange of the open chat with session.branch and count
why: The one window needs a branch action on a node; Hermes 0.23.1 supports count

decision: Merge PR 27 into outbox/competition-entry
why: Checks pass: 276 tests, bundles current

decision: Drop Merge record
why: It adds nothing, like archiving a chat

decision: Keep the lanes of PR 27; do not port VS Code lane code
why: The port changes VS Code's core loop and collapse feeds it new input, so its tests stop vouching for it

decision: One merge section for the open chat with Merge as-is and Digest
why: Rohan's rule

decision: Merge into any ancestor; the target lane lights up
why: Rohan's rule

decision: Never pass a name when branching; Hermes names chats
why: A passed name counts as user-typed, so Hermes never renames it

decision: Digest is model-written through ctx.llm.complete_structured; a fork digests the part above the fork
why: Rohan's rule
result: chosen; replaces the question plus final answer digest

decision: chat-tree gets a Python half with a /digest route
why: ctx.llm lives on the Python PluginContext

decision: The user picks the branch model and reasoning level in ModelCatalogMenu; no assumed cheap model
why: Rohan: the user gets to choose

decision: model_override sends only model, provider, reasoning
why: Any other key fails with invalid_params

decision: Inline styles for exact sizes and colours; Tailwind only for classes in the shipped CSS
why: Hermes builds Tailwind once over app source; plugin classes are never scanned

decision: Show the model pill only on the open node
why: Rohan's rule

decision: Digests go through a plugin RPC method and a session event
why: Hermes documents this path for a plugin frontend; the dashboard route trick is not documented

decision: The tree reads other chats through a plugin RPC method on hermes_state SessionDB
why: session.history answers only for chats in gateway memory, so the other lanes were empty in the live app

decision: concept-links dashboard routes never mount (no dashboard/manifest.json)
why: Pre-existing; only the MDN click lookup fallback is lost
result: low urgency; fix in its own session

decision: A node click opens the chat, then scrolls to the exchange through the hermes:timeline-reveal DOM event
why: Rohan wants scroll to message; the SDK has no scroll API; the event reuses the Hermes loading and reveal logic
result: chosen; breaks catalog rule 8 (app markup reach), gets a review warning, may break on Hermes updates, disclosed in README

decision: Ask Hermes for a public reveal function
why: Catalog rule 8 says to ask for an SDK hook; the scroll uses private markup

decision: Propose a VS Code style merge and branch UI: row icon actions, a two-step popover pick, a result line
why: The merge section is noisy, has no default, and sits far from its lane

decision: A new fork shows at once: a stub node at the fork point; reload on Hermes session events
why: Rohan saw forks appear only after the first turn ended
evidence: chat-tree.js planGraph and the 15 s poll

decision: The active path uses --dt-primary, not --ui-accent
why: --ui-accent is --theme-midground, a neutral, so the active path looked like the hover path

decision: Branch shows on every answered node; a node of another chat opens that chat first
why: Hermes branches only a loaded chat; Rohan saw no way to fork

decision: The Branch question is optional; with none, the branch is made and opened
why: Rohan's question

decision: The Branch button uses GitForkIcon at 14 px, like Hermes's own branch action
why: Rohan: use the exact icon Hermes uses

decision: The merge target is a dropdown; its path lights in the hover colour only while the dropdown is in use
why: Ancestors often share a title; Rohan's rule
result: chosen; replaces the chips and the standing dashed lane

decision: history.read returns one lineage, skips hidden and archived chats, and caps the text
why: End-of-build review finding

decision: Branch cuts at branch_index + 1 from the rows Hermes branches from
why: The visible history can drop rows that Hermes counts
